model: TROXNETCOM MB-BAC-WA1/2 fire damper module (BACnet MS/TP)
equipment_type: Fire and smoke damper control module
applies_to: TROX TROXNETCOM MB-BAC-WA1/2 modules that drive and monitor up to 2 fire or smoke extract dampers (motorised or limit-switch only).
summary: The MB-BAC-WA1/2 module connects up to 2 fire or smoke dampers to BACnet MS/TP (or Modbus RTU). Per channel it has an operating-mode object, a safe position, an open/close command, position feedback, an alarm object and run-time and heartbeat timers; a test object starts a damper test for all channels. 20 objects in total; the object names are factory defaults and can be renamed.
notes: AV 1-6 and MV 3-12 are disabled by default; they appear once Damper1..2 (MV 1-2) sets a channel operating mode.
Most objects only exist in Motorised_Damper mode; ActuPos..a is only used with the two "Only_Limit_Switch" modes (two mechanical dampers per channel).
Object names, descriptions and state texts are writable and stored in EEPROM; the names here are the factory defaults.
COV is supported for ActuPos, ActuPos..a and Alarm objects (max. 10 subscriptions).
The device Model_Name reads "MB-BAC-WA1B3" in this manual.

integration.summary: Set each channel mode in Damper1..2 (MV 1-2) and its safe position, then drive motorised dampers with ActuDrive (open/close) and read ActuPos and Alarm. Write OK (1) to an Alarm object to reset it. If RcvHrtBt is set, the BMS must rewrite ActuDrive within that time.
integration.enable: A channel is only active once its Damper object (MV 1-2) is set from Inactive (1, factory) to an operating mode.
integration.heartbeat: RcvHrtBt1..2 (AV 5-6, factory 0 = off) sets the maximum time between writes to ActuDrive. If it is exceeded the channel reports Update_Error and the damper goes to its safe position; the error stays latched until reset.
setup: Default device instance 32900 + the address on hex switches X/Y.
Baud rate 9600, 19200, 38400 or 76800 on DIP switches 2 and 3.
gotchas: Only the first error per channel is reported; reset it (write OK) before another can show.
Runtime_Error and Update_Error send the damper to SafetyPos; Manipulation switches the relay off.
Configuration objects (marked RW-E) are stored in EEPROM, so set them at commissioning rather than writing them repeatedly.
